summary: The review does what was asked, and I recommend accepting it. It adds docs/design/reviews/job-planning-review-1.md and a CHANGELOG.md entry, and nothing else changes. It names the commit it reviewed (de62c08, which is the base commit here). It has a table of the design's (read) code claims, each marked confirmed, contradicted or unchecked with the line checked. Its findings for sections 3 to 9 each carry a severity, evidence and a fix. It assesses the order and size of the five build jobs and whether the keep rule can be computed from Athena's records, and it ends with the verdict "build after the listed fixes". I checked a sample of its line citations against the source and all matched: job_of at store.rs 208-221 ends in `_ => None` and the panicking `.expect` is at 275, so the review is right to contradict the design there; FindingSource at records.rs 215-218 has only Verifier and Athena, so `Critic` does not exist; and run.rs 184, 602, 653, 803, 1357, 1429, admission.rs 59/117, config.rs 318-323/330, verify.rs 246, policy.rs 76 and retry.rs 56-60 all say what the review claims. cargo fmt --check, the full cargo test --locked and the xtask policy boundary test all passed. Only minor points remain: the review leaves a few claims unchecked and says so, F12 is listed as a finding though it states there is nothing to fix, and records/ is absent here, so the figures it takes from records were not checked in this snapshot either.
